name: Workbench Docs Assistant

docsBaseUrl.description: Documentation site to index. Any site with a sitemap.xml works; pages under /docs/ are indexed.

geminiModel.description: Gemini model on Vertex AI used to answer questions

vertexLocation.description: Vertex AI location for the Gemini model

assistantTitle.description: Title shown in the app header
